text:
yara: Following the postmortem action triage for the 03/18 surge — I'm compiling owners for GPU capacity/autoscale remediation. Please ack and add blockers or ETA changes.

yara: Proposed actions (brief):
- emergency quota + provider escalation (owner: ajay, ETA: 2026-03-24)
- scheduler knobs: shorten preempt window, tweak binpack scoring, descheduler rule (owner: mike, ETA: 2026-03-22)
- cluster headroom: define % per tier + warm-cache strategy (owner: helena, ETA: 2026-04-01)
- autoscale harness: replay spike + validate step-scale windows (owner: yara, ETA: 2026-03-29)
- runbook + KPIs: add surge checklist, KPI sheet (owner: yara, ETA: 2026-03-20)

ajay: Ack. Opening emergency ticket now and will paste link. For long-term quota we'll need usage curves 1 data-ops?

mike: Ack. Plan: preempt 120s->30s, binpack weight +/-10%, descheduler to evict short background pods first. I'll post a canary config for eng-infra and include rollback criteria.

helena: Ack. For headroom sims I suggest starting with 15% prod / 20% high-p99 workloads. I'll run region-wide replays and report variance. Need the sanitized trace link.

yara: Trace is in the postmortem doc: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/INC-2026-03-18/trace-sample. Fields: ts, req_type, tokens.

mike: Canary will emit metrics: p50/p95 token latency, preemption_count, scale_latency. Rollback if p95 >5% reg or preemptions >2x.

ajay: Ticket created: https://cloud.vendor/support/Q-8890. Adding provider contacts and requested SKUs.

ops-bot: Reminder set: "GPU capacity & autoscale follow-ups" starting 2026-03-23 09:30 PT (recurrence: weekly). Assigned to: yara, ajay, mike.

yara: For the autoscale harness I'll wire up a replay job. Example command for local run:

````
kubectl run replay-spike --image=redwood/loadgen:latest --restart=OnFailure -- /bin/sh -c "python replay_spike.py --trace trace-sample.json --duration 600"
````

helena: One constraint: eu-west provider headroom limited. We should mark eu-west as constrained in the runbook and prefer us-west/us-east for immediate fallbacks.

yara: Good call. I'll update the runbook and KPI sheet with region constraints.

mike: Blocker: binpack changes might hurt small-request tail. Canary will include small-request tail slices and a rollback threshold.

ajay: I'll escalate staging GPU allocation for canary runs. Tag me with preferred windows.

yara: Recap / next steps: 1) owners ack (done) 2) mike posts canary config by 03/21 3) ajay files quota + escalate by 03/24 4) helena runs headroom sims by 04/01 5) yara runs autoscale harness by 03/29 6) weekly check-ins until items green. If ETAs slip >48h escalate to eng-sre lead.

mike: I'll post canary and tag results here. Starting target: 2026-03-21 08:00 PT.

ajay: Noted. Will update incident tracker and link tickets.

yara: Thanks everyone 1 I'll send calendar invites for the weekly sync and drop the tracker link. :thumbsup:
